————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;

Measures to counter violence in North
Eastern Region
*1. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in just over
two years 35 major incidents of violence
were reported from the North Eastern
Region; and
(b) the measures taken  to counter  the
militant groups operating  in North Eastern
States?
Sexual harassment of women in police
custody
†*2. SHRIMATI  KAMLA MANHAR:
Will  the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been an increase
in the cases of sexual harassment of women
in police custody; and
(b) if so, the State-wise details  in the
above cases and the number of guilty
punished during the last three years?
MIG-21 aircraft crashes
†*3. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of MIG-21 aircrafts that
crashed in the last five years;
(b) the number of pilots and army
officials killed in such air crashes during
the last five years; and
(c) the reasons for the continuous
accidents of MIG-21 aircrafts?
Strategy for Commonwealth
Games 2010
*4. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a sports strategy and
plan in place in view of the coming 2010
Commonwealth Games in New Delhi;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

2
Server3\Session Nov-Dec 2004\Rajya Sabha\QL\2872RS\2872RS.p65
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Killings of elderly people in Delhi
*5. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:  Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of elderly couples
murdered in Delhi since January, 2004;
(b) the number of killers of these elderly
couples arrested/nabbed; and
(c) the concrete steps Government have
taken for the safety of the elderly people?
Compensation to disabled soldiers
*6. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether, as reported in the media it
is a fact that 40 thousand  soldiers who
were injured  in battlefield  have not got
compensation as given to others;
(b) whether there was any
representation from  such  groups of
soldiers; and
(c) how far Ex-servicemen Contributory
Health Services give help or benefits to
such disabled soldiers?
 Measures to improve  standard of
sports
†*7. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that adequate
measures are not being taken to improve
the standard of sports in the country;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that due to
ever increasing influence of politics and
commercialization in the field of sports,
problems are being faced  to improve the
standard of sports; and
(d) if not, the  reaction of Government
in this regard?
Provision of safe drinking water
*8. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of villages in the country
where Government has not been able
to provide safe drinking water, State-
wise;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
provide safe drinking  water to the people
of these villages;
(c) the total amount provided to each
of the State Government for this purpose;
(d) whether the Central Government
propose to take this task of providing safe
drinking water on war footing with
assistance from private sector;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the  reasons therefor?
Workers killed/injured due to collapse
of portion of T3 tunnel of Tehri Dam
*9. SHRI AMAR SINGH:  Will the
Minister of POWER  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that  a  large
number of workers have been killed and
injured as a result of collpase of unlined
portion of T3 tunnel of Tehri Dam;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the matter has been probed
by Government and if  so, by whom and
what are its findings?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3

Investment  for  strengthening  the
power transmission system in the
Southern Region
*10. SHRIMATI  S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of POWER  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have approved an investment of Rs. 285
crores  for strengthening the power
transmission system in the Southern
Region;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that many
State Governments in Southern Region
have demanded more investment in power
sector by the Government to enhance the
power supply in this region; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Test flights of LCA  'TEJAS'
*11. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:  Will
the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the indigenous Light
Combat Aircraft (LCA) TEJAS   has been
successfully tested;
(b) if so, the results of the test flights;
and
(c) its main features as compared to
LCAs in use with other international air-
forces and its comparative cost?
Inquiry into use of banned drugs by
athletes of  Athens Olympics
*12. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had ordered a
high level inquiry into the use of banned
drugs by our athletes before and during
Athens Olympics;
(b) if so, whether the inquiry report has
since been submitted to Government;
and
(c) if so, the findings thereof and the
action taken by Government thereon?
Early warning systems to deal with
natural disasters
*13. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
     SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minsiter of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that  Government
propose to frame a policy and legal
framework for disaster management  that
would  lay  down precautionary and
preventive measures;
(b) if  so,  the details thereof; and
(c) how far  the proposed measures
would help to control the impact of  natural
calamities?
"Food  for Work" Programme for
backward districts
*14. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:  Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a "Food for
Work" Programme has been formulated for
150 most backward districts in the country;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the criteria evolved for identifying  the most
backward districts, the number of such
beneficiary districts selected, State-wise,
and the role assigned to and financial
obligation, if any, of the States in
implementing the programme?

4
Server3\Session Nov-Dec 2004\Rajya Sabha\QL\2872RS\2872RS.p65
Increase in Naxal and Maoist
activities
†*15. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the States where signs of increase
in the activities of Naxal and Maoist
organizations  has been noticed and  what
have been the results thereof; and
(b) the initiative Government have
taken to bring the misguided youths of the
Maoist and Naxal organisations into the
mainstream and the results thereof?
Foodgrains provided under "Food
for Work" programme
†*16. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
continue the "Food for Work" programme;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
and
(c) the number of States to  whom
foodgrains have been provided free of cost
so far?
Migration  from rural areas to cities
*17. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
survey of migration  of rural people to cities
seeking better living conditions:
(b) if so,  whether the percentage of such
migration  during the last decade has came
down or gone up; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
bring down this migration to cities?
Sick Jute Mills in Public
Sector
†*18. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many Jute
Mills being run in public sector in various
States of the country have become sick or
on the verge of becoming sick;
(b) if so, the names of that States in the
country where Jute Mills were running in
public sector till July, 2004;
(c) the number of mills  among the said
mills  which have become sick and number
of mills which are running in losses; and
(d) the outstanding amount till  July,
2004 regarding Provident fund, E.S.I. and
gratuity against these mills?
Multi-purpose Identity cards in
Meghalaya
*19. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:  Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS   be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Meghalaya Government
has urged the Centre to introduce multi
purpose identity cards to check the influx
of foreign nationals into the State;
and
(b) if so, the action taken or proposed
to be taken to issue citizen's identity cards
to check illegal migration?
Import of raw silk from China
*20. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES  be pleased to
state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(a) whether it is a fact that our silk
exporters are forced to import raw silk from
China due to inferior quality of our raw
silk and its high price;
(b) whether it is a fact that the price of
Chinese silk  is lower than that of ours;
(c) whether Government have enquired
into the matter to overcome these
shortcomings; and
(d) if so, what are its end-results?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,

Training facilities for MES officers and
staff
1. SHRI  KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the  Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the strength
of MES Officers and subordinate staff is
approximately 1.5 lakh;
(b) if so, whether there are any training
facilities for  them;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
provide proper training institute for them;
and
(e) if so, when the institute is expected
to function?
Sending of Indian Army Commandos
to foreign countries
2.  SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
lend Indian Army's Commandos to other
countries who are on friendly terms with
our country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the manner in which the operational
cost of such commando operations would
be met?
More powers to coast guard
3. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
give more teeth to coast guard so as  to
enable it intercept and inspect all ships
within the country's exclusive economic
zone;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any other country has given
this kind of power to their coast guard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Appointment of more women doctors
in the Army
4. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry propose to
appoint more women doctors in the Army

2
Server3\Session Nov-Dec 2004\Rajya Sabha\QL\2874RS\2874RS.p65
looking at th e increasing number of
aspirants in the force;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of women doctors in the
Indian Army as on 1st December, 2004?
Benefits to Kargil war widows
5. SHRIMATI  PREMA  CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that even after
five years of Kargil operation many war
widows have not got any benefit from
State/Central Government although a lot
of things were announced at that time;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
details of war widows who are still to get
the due benefits; and
(c) by when the remaining war widows
will get their dues?
Death of pilots and civilians in MIG
crashes
6. SHRI  DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have compiled
the latest figures of the total number of
Indian Air Force (IAF) pilots killed in MIG
crashes since 1971;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of civilians killed in
these MIG crashes;
(d) the loss in terms of money suffered
by the IAF pilots; and
(e) whether any concrete measures have
been taken to improve the situation and if
so, the details thereof?
Physical tests of women aspirants to
the Army
7. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that unmarried
women candidates between the ages of 21
to 27 are made to undergo physical test,
including gynaecological tests by male
doctors for the past ten years as part of the
recruitment process in the Army; and
(b) the remedial measures proposed to
get this sensitive issue affecting women
resolved?
 State of bridges constructed at
Tanakpur-Tawaghat road
†8. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) when the improvement and
broadening work at the Tanakpur-Tawaghat
motorable road was undertaken and by
when the same is likely to be completed;
(b) whether it is a fact that most of the
bridges constructed thereon have turned
unusable and some of them have been
closed down for traffic; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
action being taken against the persons
responsible therefor?
Shifting effect  of Idgah abattoir
on IAF
 9. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Indian Air Force is
against the shifting of Idgah slaughter
house to Ghazipur near the Hindon Air
Base in Ghaziabad;

(b) if so, the action taken to ensure that
accidents involving bird hits posing great
risk for  the fighters are avoided by shifting
the abattoir?
Training of Indian pilots on Hawk Jets
at RAF
10. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the first batch of Indian
pilots for training on Hawk Jets at the Royal
Air Force Valley in Wales has been sent as
per schedule; and
(b) if so, the details of pilots who have
been sent for training as a part of agreement
between India and RAF?
Organ transplant racket by Army
doctors
11. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Army doctors
in the Premier Army Research and Referral
Hospital are involved in organ transplant
racket;
(b) if so, the datails thereof;
(c) whether Government have arrested
some persons involved in the racket; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Reduction of army personnel in
Jammu and Kashmir
12. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
SHRI R. S. GAVAI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
propose to reduce the Army personnel in
Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that terrorist
violence in the State of Jammu and
Kashmir has escalated; and
(d) if so, the reasons for reducing the
soldiers in Jammu and Kashmir?
Steps to make Air Force more effective
13. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a
comprehensive manpower down-sizing
exercise has been undertaken recently in
the Indian Air Force; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the steps initiated for institutional changes,
if any, and for improving the man, machine
and fire power ratio, for a more effective
Air Force?
Crash of Mirage aircrafts
14. SHRIMATI  S.G. INDIRA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that three Mirage
aircrafts had crashed within one month
between September, 2004 and October,
2004;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any probe has been ordered
into these crashes;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether Government propose to
ground Mirage aircrafts in view of these
air-crashes?
Export of ALHs
15. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact  that we have
good export potential for the indigenously
manufactured Advanced Light Helicopters
(ALHs);

4
Server3\Session Nov-Dec 2004\Rajya Sabha\QL\2874RS\2874RS.p65
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether we have received orders for
these helicopters from other countries; if
so, the details thereof indicating the amount
of foreign exchange so far  earned out of
these deals?
Discriminatory treatment to defence
pensioners
16. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Defence pensioners below
officers rank living in Delhi have to present
themselves physically before the Defence
Pension Disbursing Officer at Red Fort on
appointed dates for signing the annual
identification certificates in his presence,
which cause them avoidable hardship and
discomfort, particularly to the infirm sick
and the old;
(b) whether the civilian pensioners sign
such certificates in the bank branches, from
where they actually draw their pension; and
(c) if so, why this discrimination and
whether Government propose to rectify the
same; if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Naming of Uttaranchal as
Uttarakhand
†17. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased
to state:
(a)  whether Government are aware of
the fact that the people of Uttaranchal have
been making a demand since the very
inception of  the  State to change the name
of the State  as Uttarakhand;
(b) if so, whether State Government has
sent any such proposal to the Centre; and
(c) the dates of sending such proposals
by State Government and by when
Government are likely to take action
thereon?
Socio-economic development in naxal-
affected areas
18. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI  DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had convened
a meeting of top officers of naxal-affected
States on the 5th August, 2004 on the
security and socio-economic development
in the naxal-affected areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
names of States represented in the meeting;
(c) whether any agreement has reached
in the meeting  between the States and the
Centre;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the Union Government
have agreed to make available money to
these States for security and socio-
economic development of the naxal-
affected areas; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Security to tourists visiting J & K
19. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the steps taken by
Government to provide security to tourists
visiting Jammu and Kashmir during the
current year; and
(b) the details of the steps the Union
Government propose to take to ensure that
both tourists and pilgrims visiting Jammu
and  Kashmir are safe from militancy?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

5

National policy to tackle Naxal menace
20. SHRIMATI PREMA CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Chief Ministers of three
States—Orissa, Jharkhand and
Chhattisgarh had sought during the Chief
Ministers’ Conference in Hyderabad on
20th September, 2004 formulation of a
national policy on tackling Naxals;
(b) if so, the reaction of the Centre
thereto; and
(c) the details of the assistance being
given/proposed to be given to the Naxal
affected States particularly Andhra Pradesh
and Karnataka by the Centre?
Effect of Maoists activities on school
going children
†21. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
children are reluctant to go to schools
because of kidnapping of children by
Maoists in Jharkhand and some other parts
of the country;
(b) the areas where as per Government's
information Maoists are active; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to check Maoist menace?
Crimes against SCs/STs
22. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
the National Crime Records Bureau the
crimes against SCs and STs are alarmingly
increased during the last five years;
(b) if so, the details of crimes that have
been committed against SCs/STs during the
last five years; and
(c) what preventive measures
Government are taking or proposed to take,
in co-ordination with the States, to reduce
the number of crimes against SCs/STs?
Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act,
1980 in Manipur
†23. SHRIMATI  MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) what were the main reasons for
administering Armed Forces (Special
Powers) Act, 1980 in the State of Manipur;
(b) whether it is a fact that despite
administering this Act, there has been an
increase in the insurgency activities by
different tribal groups not only in Manipur
but in various regions of entire North-
Eastern States during the last many years;
and
(c) if so, the action taken by the Central
Government in recent past and details of
the success achieved?
Introduction of FBI-like force to tackle
terrorism
24. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are seriously
thinking of introducing FBI-like force to
tackle terrorism, naxalism and organized
crime in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are going to
seek constitutional amendment for this
purpose since public order is a State
subject; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(d) if so, the details thereof?
Peace talks in J&K
†25. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any talks of  Government
with any organisation or political party with
regard to Jammu and Kashmir are going
on;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of steps Government are
going to take in near future with regard to
J & K so that disturbances can be brought
down there?
Special Task Force to deal with
naxalite organisations
†26. SHRI PYARELAL KHANDEL-
WAL: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the efforts being made by
Government to bring peace in naxal
affected areas of different States;
(b) whether Government are
considering to set up a special task force
to deal with naxalite organisations
effectively; and
(c) the details of the naxalite
organisations identified by Government
and the areas of their operations?
Raising of National Emergency
Response Force
27. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to raise a National Emergency
Response Force (NERF) to tackle
calamities arising out of nuclear, biological
or chemical disaster;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the time-frame within which the
force is proposed to be raised?
World Bank assistance to upgrade fire
fighting services
28. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most States
have submitted their project reports seeking
funds to acquire sophisticated equipment
for their fire fighting services, as part of
disaster management infrastructure, to meet
the challenge of growing terrorist  activities
in the country;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof,
and the action taken/proposed to be taken
in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government are negotiating with the World
Bank for Rs. 1,000  crore loan to upgrade
fire services departments in various States;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and its
present status?
Policy to deal with terrorism and drug-
trafficking in North-Eastern States
29. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state the
comprehensive policy proposed to be
framed to deal with the complex problems
of terrorism, drug-trafficking etc. in North-
Eastern States?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

7
Server3\Session Nov-Dec 2004\Rajya Sabha\QL\2874RS\2874RS.p65
Depleting conventional sources of energy
30. SHRI JANARDHANA POOJARY:
Will the Minister of NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the conventional sources of
energy are depleting over the years and are
becoming uneconomical;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether other sources of energy are
being searched and identified to meet the
